name.description: The tool's name as a person reads it ("Send email"). It names the panel.

identifier.description: The tool's identifier ("send-email"), small and monospaced after the name.

duration.description: How long the call took, formatted by the caller ("10.0s").

position.description: Where the call falls in its turn ("call 28 of 30").

summary.description: The line under the name, replacing the status word, duration and position.

message.description: What went wrong, in words ("No reply from mail.example.com after 10s"). Shown first.

code.description: The machine code for the failure ("smtp-timeout"), in small monospace.

retryable.description: Whether trying the call again can work. Written "Yes" or "No".

retryMessage.description: The message the retry button sends as the person's own.

resolving.description: The answer that is on its way for a waiting call.

placement.description: How the panel sits on the page.

dockedFrom.description: The viewport width the panel docks from.

unsupportedProps.name: children
unsupportedProps.description: Extra sections after the Input and Result, such as a link to the run.

unsupportedProps.name: onApprove
unsupportedProps.description: Fired with the note when Approve is pressed on a `waiting` call. The decision bar shows only when this or `onDeny` is set.

unsupportedProps.name: onClose
unsupportedProps.description:
Fired once each time the panel closes, whether by its X, Close, Esc or the caller setting
`open` to `false`. A page hands focus back to the call's row here, with `focusCall(id)` on the
rail.

unsupportedProps.name: onDeny
unsupportedProps.description: Fired with the note when Deny is pressed on a `waiting` call. If the person denies, the agent reads the note as the reason.

unsupportedProps.name: onRetry
unsupportedProps.description: Fired when the person asks the agent to retry a `failed` call. The button is secondary, full width, and shows only when this is set.
